description: Application for Reserved Matters Approval for layout, scale, design, appearance, access and landscaping pursuant to Condition 5 of the Bridgewater Triangle Outline Planning Permission [reference to s73 permission to vary Outline Planning Permission 21/00403/OUT_LLDC to be added] comprising the construction of buildings providing residential units and supporting Commercial, Business and Service use (Class E) and Community use (Class F.1/F.2) with associated car and cycle parking, play space, public realm, landscaping, access and associated works.
